records.summary: Refreshed the Ripple-associated XRPL wallet lineage through rJqi→rP4X2h→raRVLN, captured the 20M raRVLN→r39TA transfer and two 20:47 r39TA→Binance-labelled rNxp4h deposits, reconciled approximate account-balance changes, and compared the route with TrackWhale's seven-day tracked large-transfer net outflow and current ETF/derivatives snapshots. Separately audited the current main branch, stacked research-ledger PR chain, safety PR checks and stale prediction evaluator.
actions: Inspected current main, current research PR head, stacked PR bases, open safety PRs and exact-head CI/gate runs before writing.
Refreshed public Bithomp account and transaction pages for rJqi, rP4X2h, raRVLN, r39TA and Binance-labelled rNxp4h.
Verified the 20:47 UTC two-payment r39TA→rNxp4h deposit sequence and captured the approximate rNxp4h balance increase.
Retained the AMM/vault/loan-broker and same-unit provenance limitations; did not classify deposits as sales or reserve replenishment.
Compared selected large-transfer flow data with ETF and provider-specific derivatives data without averaging incompatible coverage.
Appended new source, run-update and limitation shards plus immutable snapshot, graph, architecture decision and repository audit on the existing research branch only.
blockers: raRVLN AMM pair, vault identifier, loan-broker identifier and collateral objects remain unresolved because the explorer rate-limited ledger-object reads.
r39TA beneficial owner and complete XRP/RLUSD transaction history remain unknown.
rNxp4h function and October 1 Binance PoR membership remain unknown; no XRP-specific replenishment is established.
The attacker XRP receiver has not been refreshed after the prior captured observation.
TrackWhale is a selected large-transfer sample; ETF and derivatives providers have different universes and cutoffs.
No synchronized historical market panel or calibrated fixed-horizon XRP model is validated.
Research-ledger PR stack is based on an old main SHA and is not directly ready for main review.
next_actions: Obtain the official October 1 Binance PoR all-address export and crosswalk all five compromised XRPL source accounts plus rNxp4h and XRP-BF2 reserve addresses.
Resolve raRVLN AMM pair, vault and loan-broker objects from a rate-limit-safe XRPL data source.
Reconcile the full r39TA transaction history and identify its service or beneficial owner only from public evidence.
Monitor rNxp4h and the attacker receiver separately; distinguish customer deposits, exchange inventory, reserve replenishment and executed sales.
Build a venue-normalized XRP spot/perpetual/ETF/large-transfer panel with source-specific coverage metadata.
Prepare a fresh-main migration plan for the stacked research-ledger PR chain before any merge request.
Continue fixed-horizon evaluator implementation only after point-in-time feature and outcome stores are available.
